name: Naamapadam: Named Entity Annotated Data for Indic Languages
description: Naamapadam is the largest publicly available named entity annotated dataset for 11 major Indic languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu). Curated by AI4Bharat, the dataset extracts entity annotations from parallel sentence corpora in Samanantar using high-precision cross-lingual candidate selection and multilingual transformer projection, providing 4,964,286 sentences annotated with Person (PER), Location (LOC), and Organization (ORG) tags.
